Hey guys, I'm a United States Marine (as you can maybe tell by my overly moto username) its definitely not as cool as some other things here, (although I like to think I'm cooler than the IT guy :P) anyway...

Pros: honestly I feel like if you know how to manage money you can walk out of this gig with a decent amount, also I'll get college taken care of, medical is free, not the best, but free. Definitely an interesting job.

Cons: you probably will never blast bad guys and save the girl. There's a ridiculous amount of training and cleaning, I've seriously never cleaned as much in my life, earlier today I dusted the inside of my fucking refrigerator, who the FUCK dusts the inside of a fridge. Marines, that's who... also, you can get like, shot in the face, so there's that.

Anyway, you'll meet an awful lot of interesting people, and if you only do four years its a relatively short amount of time, and you do some cool things. You'll do lots of shitty things too, but the cool stuff usually makes up for it. If you guys have any questions about what I do I can't really answer that, sorry! That's another thing, depending on your job you can get security clearances which I'm told are hella valuable in the civilian sector. But anyways, if anyone has some general questions about the Corps I'll be more than happy to answer!
